digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler runtime — Cloud/DC backend initialization
propositions: _build_datacenter defers all validation to lazy _LazyDataCenterClient, creating asymmetry with _build_cloud which calls assert_cloud_scope_ready at build time.
assert_cloud_scope_ready enforces stricter checks (email-format JIRA_USER, non-empty project) than legacy ambient assert_env_ready, but this tightening is undocumented.
A new assert_datacenter_nonsecret_scope_ready must validate base_url and jira.project at build time in _build_datacenter, while preserving lazy validation of JIRA_PAT and network connectivity.
DC backend composition must not require JIRA_PAT or the [agents] extra at build time, only at client initialization.
The stricter Cloud scope checks must be documented as intentional, canonical tightening rather than accidental drift from legacy ambient validation.
assert_cloud_scope_ready and JiraBackend.assert_env_ready docstrings must clarify that email format and non-empty project checks are deliberate, required constraints not compatibility compromises.
